binding_models.claim_boundary: Reference package model for this conformance profile, not a claim about every future USS binding.
binding_models.description: Native reference profile carries the full semantic projection.

binding_models.claim_boundary: Pilot model of public LeRobotDataset v3 metadata used in this repository; not a complete judgment of all LeRobot extensions.
binding_models.description: Policy-training table view with episode/task, clocks, action tensors, and trace storage.

binding_models.claim_boundary: Pilot model of fields represented in the controlled Rerun binding artifact, not a universal Rerun capability score.
binding_models.description: Multirate physical-data recording view with frames, clocks, entities, traces, and events.

binding_models.claim_boundary: Pilot model based on public NCore capture and pose-graph scope; not a claim that NCore could not be extended.
binding_models.description: Sensor and reconstruction capture view with embodiment, frames, clocks, assets, and provenance.

binding_models.claim_boundary: Pilot model of common ROS2/MCAP logs; schemas can carry more when explicitly authored.
binding_models.description: Raw robotics log view with episode messages, transforms, clocks, actions, and trace streams.

binding_models.claim_boundary: Pilot model of scene composition and simulation asset metadata; not an action/task dataset profile.
binding_models.description: Composed simulation-world view with world assets, entities, representation roles, frames, and replay assumptions.

binding_models.claim_boundary: Asset binding only; it is intentionally not an episode, task, action, clock, split, or replay contract.
binding_models.description: Portable Gaussian appearance asset view with entity and asset representation metadata.

claim_boundary: This profile is a versioned pilot projection for binding-retention experiments. It is not a universal score of any external format and should be revised through external review before becoming normative.
